subject: POC/trial: model selection & evaluation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@novaterra.com>, Priya Singh <priya@novaterra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC/trial: model selection & evaluation plan

Hi Carlos & Priya

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Below is a concise recap and proposed plan for the 2-week POC so we can align on success criteria, owners, timeline, and the models we plan to test. Please review and let me know any edits.

1) Goal: validate that Redwood can serve a multilingual Q&A and summarization feature for Novaterra support docs with latency <200ms p50 and quality parity with your current baseline for en/es/fr/de.

2) Success criteria (examples we discussed):
- Latency: p50 <200ms, p95 <350ms at expected pilot load (~1\u20132 rps sustained, bursts to 5 rps).
- Quality: >85% macro-accuracy/utility on labeled QA set (we'll use your 250-sample benchmark) and acceptable summarization ROUGE/L-based checks agreed after kickoff.
- Cost: token/unit cost estimates within 2x of your current hosted baseline for the target throughput.

3) Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Novaterra: provide labeled QA set (250 samples), list of top 200 support pages, and expected query distribution by language (Priya + Lisa).
- Redwood: stand up POC environment, run model evaluation harness (Marissa), collect latency/cost metrics and produce an evaluation report (Ben).

4) Models we propose to test (initial lineup):
- Primary: Llama-2-13b-chat (quantized 4-bit) \u2014 best balance of multilingual support and instruction-following.
- Secondary / fallback: Mistral-7B-instruct (optimized client-side) \u2014 lower cost for fallback paths.
- Edge-case fallback: Llama-2-7b (faster, smaller; useful if we need lower-latency config).
Notes: we'll test both quantized and non-quantized variants to compare quality vs cost. If needed, we can add Falcon-40B-instruct to the list but only if higher-capacity modeling is required.

5) Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): sign off on scope, share datasets + access for Redwood.
- Week 1: baseline runs (Llama-2-13b-chat quantized + Mistral-7B runs), collect metrics.
- Week 2: tuning, fallback testing, final evaluation report and review call.

6) Next steps:
- Novaterra: share the QA dataset and top support pages by Monday EOD (Priya).
- Redwood: deliver environment access and initial run plan by Tuesday (Marissa).
- Schedule POC kickoff call for Monday 23 Nov, 10:00am PT (proposed).

Attachments: attached a one-page POC_Scope.pdf and a short Technical_Requirements.xlsx with ports/keys/data formats. Also attaching a SOC2 excerpt you requested.

Thanks \u2014 excited to get this started.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference (www.redwood.inference)

From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@novaterra.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Priya Singh <priya@novaterra.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@novaterra.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC/trial: model selection & evaluation plan

Marissa \u2014 thanks for the clear recap. This looks good to us. A few clarifications/requests: 

- We can deliver the labeled QA set and language distribution by EOD Tuesday.
- For success criteria on summarization, can you add a human-eval checklist we can run (conciseness, hallucination rate <5%, and preservation of critical facts)?
- We want the POC report to include token-cost projections for projected steady-state (10k qs/day) \u2014 even if rough.

Also, one ask re: models: Spanish and Portuguese support is super important for us. Do you expect Llama-2-13b-chat to hold up on Portuguese as well, or should we include an additional multilingual-fine-tuned variant?

If you can confirm the kickoff time and share the drive link for artifacts, we\u2019ll be set.

Thanks,
Carlos
Head of Product, Novaterra

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@novaterra.com>, Priya Singh <priya@novaterra.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@novaterra.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC/trial: model selection & evaluation plan

Internal note \u2014 looping you in with proposed model-config specifics to address Novaterra's Portuguese + latency asks.

Plan suggestions:
- Primary test: Llama-2-13b-chat (4-bit quantized) served on Redwood dedicated small instance; expect p50 ~130\u2013180ms for single conversation context (we'll tune batch size).
- Multilingual boost: run a fallback trial with Mistral-7B-instruct and a Portuguese-finetuned Llama-2-13b variant (if Novaterra prefers, we can apply a small-shot finetune with their 2k examples after initial runs).
- Cost projections: initial estimate attached in Tech_Requirements.xlsx (tab: cost_estimates). Rough numbers indicate quantized Llama-2-13b at ~1.5x cost vs Mistral-7B on equivalent throughput.
- Fallback policy: route to Mistral-7B for Portuguese-heavy requests if quality lags; route to Llama-2-7b for low-latency, low-cost mode during non-peak hours.

I'll prepare the evaluation harness: per-language accuracy, ROUGE for summarization, hallucination checklist, and latency/cost dashboards. Assigning ownership: Ben (evaluation harness + report), Marissa (POC lead & infra), Laura (contract/ procurement gating).

\u2014Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference
